summary: This video showcases how an instructional coach uses Gemini for Google Workspace to efficiently create and distribute lesson plans. It demonstrates Gemini's ability to draft detailed lesson plans, including objectives, procedures, and differentiation strategies, within Google Docs, and then highlights the ease of sharing these resources via Google Classroom.

events.title: Introduction of Gemini for Google Workspace
events.description: The video begins by introducing 'Gemini for Google Workspace' with its logo.

events.title: Instructional Coach's Challenge
events.description: An instructional coach expresses his struggle to complete regular tasks due to limited time, while visual cues around him depict typical work items like a whiteboard, calendar, and notebook.

evidence.quote: In my work as an instructional coach, I struggle to get some of my regular to-dos done in the limited amount of time I have.

events.title: Discovering Gemini
events.description: The instructional coach expresses excitement about learning about Gemini, as the scene transitions to a laptop displaying 'Hello. Gemini for Cymbal Academy'.

evidence.quote: So I was excited to learn about Gemini.

events.title: Drafting a Lesson Plan with Gemini in Google Docs
events.description: The coach uses Gemini within Google Docs to draft a lesson plan template for a 6th-grade biology class on cellular structures. He types a detailed prompt requesting ideas for new and advanced learners.

evidence.quote: Today, I'm using it to create a lesson plan template in Google Docs.

Acting as an instructional coach, draft a lesson plan for a 6th grade biology class about cellular structures. Include ideas for how to accommodate students who are new to the topic and provide extension activities for more advanced learners.

events.title: Initiating Lesson Plan Generation
events.description: The user clicks the 'Create' button to generate the lesson plan based on the typed prompt.

events.title: Gemini Generates Detailed Lesson Plan
events.description: Gemini rapidly generates a comprehensive lesson plan draft, including objectives, materials, procedures, assessment methods, and differentiated activities for both new and advanced learners.

evidence.quote: Gemini quickly generates a draft that includes objectives, steps to follow, and even ways to adapt the material for students who are new to the topic and advanced learners.

events.title: Inserting Generated Content
events.description: The user clicks the 'Insert' button to add the generated lesson plan directly into the Google Doc.

events.title: Distributing Content via Google Classroom
events.description: The coach explains how easily content created with Gemini can be distributed to educators in the district by uploading it to a shareable template in Google Classroom, visually depicting a Google Doc being shared to a Google Classroom icon surrounded by diverse educators.

evidence.quote: I can also easily distribute content I create with Gemini to educators in my district by uploading it to a shareable class template in Google Classroom.

events.title: Final Branding
events.description: The video concludes with the 'Gemini for Google Workspace' logo.

transcript.text: In my work as an instructional coach, I struggle to get some of my regular to-dos done in the limited amount of time I have.
So I was excited to learn about Gemini.
Today, I'm using it to create a lesson plan template in Google Docs.
Gemini quickly generates a draft that includes objectives, steps to follow, and even ways to adapt the material for students who are new to the topic and advanced learners.
I can also easily distribute content I create with Gemini to educators in my district by uploading it to a shareable class template in Google Classroom.

title: Create a lesson plan template using Gemini in Docs
